comment: Generated by `cd proto/go && go test ./solana/zsescrow -run TestAckVectors -update`. relayed_acks: an ack transaction someone else built, its message and the spec its payer holds; verdict is "ok" or the field slug of the check that refuses it. source "fixture" is the program's own transaction of that name in solana_tx_vectors.json; "built" is one built here. digests: the ack digest the payer signs off chain for a receipt, or the slug that refuses the receipt. genesis_hash is hex; ticket ids are hex; receipts are proto's receipt JSON.

relayed_acks.name: ack
relayed_acks.about: the payer posts the second half, matching the node's pending claim, itself, as submitter and fee payer, which settles it

relayed_acks.name: ack_first_half
relayed_acks.about: the payer posts the first half on an open ticket, as submitter and fee payer; it refunds in full at the deadline unless the node answers

relayed_acks.name: ack_mismatch
relayed_acks.about: the payer answers the node's pending claim with other fields, whose counts don't fit a u32, which freezes the ticket

relayed_acks.name: ack_relayed
relayed_acks.about: the payer's ack of its pending ticket, sent by a relayer (here the node) as fee payer, the payer signing as submitter

relayed_acks.name: ack_extra_settle
relayed_acks.about: as ack_relayed, with a settle_cooperative of another of the payer's claimed tickets beside the ack, which the payer's signature on the transaction acks

relayed_acks.name: from_the_builders
relayed_acks.about: a relayed ack under a compute-unit limit and price, from the builders

relayed_acks.name: another_relayer
relayed_acks.about: the ack paid for by a key that is neither the node nor the payer

relayed_acks.name: readonly_fallback
relayed_acks.about: the ack passing the treasury's USDC account read-only, which the program uses only for a refund the payer's account can't take

relayed_acks.name: writable_fallback
relayed_acks.about: the ack passing the treasury's USDC account writable, accepted: the program forfeits a refund the payer's account can't take on every ending

relayed_acks.name: treasury_of_another
relayed_acks.about: the ack passing another key's USDC account where the treasury's goes

relayed_acks.name: treasury_unknown
relayed_acks.about: the ack passing the treasury's USDC account, judged by a payer that names no treasury

relayed_acks.name: default_key_fallback
relayed_acks.about: the ack passing the default key's USDC account as its refund fallback, judged by a payer that names no treasury

relayed_acks.name: truncated
relayed_acks.about: the relayed ack's message with its last byte cut

relayed_acks.name: lookup_table
relayed_acks.about: the ack as a v0 message that loads one address from a lookup table no instruction reads

relayed_acks.name: payer_pays
relayed_acks.about: the payer as its own fee payer: one signer, a transaction the payer builds itself

relayed_acks.name: extra_signer
relayed_acks.about: the header requires a third signature, by a key no instruction references

relayed_acks.name: another_payer
relayed_acks.about: the ack judged by a payer it does not name

relayed_acks.name: payer_writable
relayed_acks.about: the ack names the payer's wallet as its rent payer, so the header grants the payer a write lock

relayed_acks.name: heap_frame
relayed_acks.about: a RequestHeapFrame before the ack

relayed_acks.name: compute_budget_twice
relayed_acks.about: a second SetComputeUnitLimit

relayed_acks.name: compute_budget_after_ack
relayed_acks.about: a compute-budget instruction after the ack

relayed_acks.name: system_transfer_beside
relayed_acks.about: a System Program transfer from the relayer's own key beside the ack

relayed_acks.name: token_transfer_beside
relayed_acks.about: a TransferChecked of the payer's USDC to another key's account beside the ack

relayed_acks.name: precompile_beside
relayed_acks.about: an Ed25519 precompile instruction before the ack

relayed_acks.name: extra_settle_ack_alone
relayed_acks.about: the program's ack_extra_settle without its settle_cooperative: the settle is all the fixture's refusal rests on

relayed_acks.name: settle_before_ack
relayed_acks.about: ack_extra_settle's settle_cooperative before the relayed ack

relayed_acks.name: escrow_no_data
relayed_acks.about: an escrow instruction with no data beside the ack

relayed_acks.name: escrow_seven_bytes
relayed_acks.about: an escrow instruction of the ack's discriminator less its last byte, beside the ack

relayed_acks.name: ack_twice
relayed_acks.about: a second ack, of another of the payer's tickets at this receipt's claim, beside the ack

relayed_acks.name: claim_beside
relayed_acks.about: the node's claim of the payer's ticket beside the ack

relayed_acks.name: compute_budget_only
relayed_acks.about: the payer as a read-only second signer of a message with only a compute budget

relayed_acks.name: ack_of_another_ticket
relayed_acks.about: an ack at this receipt's claim, of another of the payer's tickets

relayed_acks.name: ack_at_another_node
relayed_acks.about: the ack judged by a payer whose ticket is at another node

relayed_acks.name: amount_raised
relayed_acks.about: the ack charges one unit more than the receipt

relayed_acks.name: discriminator_only
relayed_acks.about: ack's discriminator with no claim

relayed_acks.name: five_accounts
relayed_acks.about: the ack cut off before its rent payer

relayed_acks.name: short
relayed_acks.about: the ack without its last account

relayed_acks.name: extra_account
relayed_acks.about: the ack with one more account after its last

relayed_acks.name: receipt_of_another_ticket
relayed_acks.about: the payer's ticket is not the one the receipt and the ack name

relayed_acks.name: receipt_ticket_unpadded
relayed_acks.about: the receipt spells the payer's ticket id without base64 padding

relayed_acks.name: no_receipt
relayed_acks.about: the payer holds no receipt for the ticket

digests.name: receipt_claim
digests.about: the receipt's claim on the relayed ack's ticket

digests.name: open_seq_max
digests.about: the same at the largest open_seq

digests.name: receipt_of_another_ticket
digests.about: the payer's ticket is not the one the receipt names

digests.name: receipt_ticket_unpadded
digests.about: the receipt spells the payer's ticket id without base64 padding

digests.name: no_receipt
digests.about: the payer holds no receipt for the ticket
